display.purpose: Provider and workflow title at the top of the main workspace.

title.purpose: Section headings such as Connection and Models.

label.purpose: Field labels, status text, and navigation labels.

shadows.name: overlay-separation
shadows.purpose: Use only when an overlay needs separation from the workspace.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Selected, hover, focus, and auto-save status changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commits the current workflow action, including launch.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #1478ff; color: #f3f7ff; border: 1px solid #1478ff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 28px; font: 600 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #2a88ff; border-color: #2a88ff; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8caff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Handles supporting actions without competing with launch.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: #101d2d; color: #f3f7ff; border: 1px solid #29415d; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 28px; font: 600 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #1c2c40; border-color: #7790ad; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8caff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Marks destructive actions such as disconnecting a provider.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { background: transparent; color: #ff5f75; border: 1px solid #ff5f75; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 28px; font: 600 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background: rgba(255, 95, 117, 0.12); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffc4cd; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Provider Navigation Item
components.description: Selects which provider configuration occupies the workspace.
components.html: OpenCode GoCodex
components.css: .ds-provider-nav { background: #0b1727; padding: 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-provider-item { display: block; color: #a9bdd8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-provider-item:hover { background: #1c2c40; color: #f3f7ff; } .ds-provider-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8caff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-provider-item-selected { background: #1478ff; color: #f3f7ff; }

components.name: Model Select
components.description: Shows a selected runtime or model value in a compact field.
components.css: .ds-field-label { color: #f3f7ff; display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-model-select { appearance: none; background: #0c1827; color: #f3f7ff; border: 1px solid #29415d; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-model-select:hover { border-color: #7790ad; } .ds-model-select:focus-visible { border-color: #1478ff; outline: 2px solid #1478ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Configuration Card
components.description: Groups one connected unit of setup work.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #101d2d; border: 1px solid #29415d; border-radius: 8px; color: #f3f7ff; padding: 20px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card p { color: #48e6a4; font-size: 14px; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Open Claude Code is a dark developer workbench for configuring a local gateway, not a dashboard that competes for attention. The interface gives structure to a short operational flow: connect a provider, choose runtime settings, then launch Claude Code. The visual language is calm, direct, and technical. It rejects gradients, ornamental illustration, visual noise, and decorative effects that dilute a tool's purpose.
keyCharacteristics: dark navy workspace with slate panel layers
cobalt blue for selected navigation and primary actions
readable forms with quiet borders and high-contrast text
green for ready and connected states, red only for destructive actions

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue marks selection and progress, not decoration. A screen should retain quiet dark surfaces around every primary action.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Green communicates connected or ready state. Red is reserved for removal and other destructive actions.

rules.name: The Plainspoken Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use type scale to explain the workflow. Avoid display styling, all-caps labels, and decorative font treatment.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a 1px structure line first. Add a soft shadow only when an overlay or focus state needs separation.

dos: Do keep the workflow ordered from connection to models to launch.
Do use cobalt blue only for selection and progress.
Do show immediate, local feedback when model settings auto-save.
Do keep connected state factual, short, and green.
donts: Don't use gradients, illustrations, decorative motifs, or glass effects.
Don't turn every container into a bright card or raised surface.
Don't use green or red as general-purpose accent colors.
Don't require a manual save action for dropdown model settings.
